title: Luigi's Mansion 3: the lights are on
body: Luigi's Mansion 3 gets a lantern of its own. The server starts, pings a real database, answers health checks and listens on the game's authentication and secure ports with its protocols registered. It has never seen a console; that first connection is the next milestone. Dark halls, friendly ghosts and a server with the lights on — the beta programme will tell us what the game asks for first.
